deadline.value: Applications for Fall PhD admission are due by December 1.
deadline.quote: Applications are due for the Ph.D. and M.S. in Biology program for Fall admission by December 1

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional and not required for the department.
gre_general.quote: GRE Scores (optional): The GRE is not required.

gre_subject.value: The biology pages do not mention a subject GRE.

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly advised to contact potential faculty mentors before applying.
supervisor.quote: Before applying to the program, we strongly recommend that you familiarize yourself with faculty researchers and reach out to potential mentors

funding.value: Every admitted PhD student gets a full tuition waiver, stipend and health-benefit support through a teaching assistantship for five years.
funding.quote: All students in Wake Forest Biology Graduate Program are admitted with a full tuition waiver, stipend support, and subsidized health benefits through Teaching Assistantships

entry_route.value: Applicants may come straight from an undergraduate degree; the department accepts seniors and graduates.
entry_route.quote: The Wake Forest University Graduate School welcomes applications from undergraduate seniors and graduates of accredited US colleges/universities or recognized foreign institutions

notes: Department page biology.wfu.edu/graduate/ (with trailing slash) returned 403 and was not used; the same content loads at biology.wfu.edu/graduate. Admission is to a department with rotations in year one. The graduate school deadline table also lists the Biology PhD as Fall, December 1.
